sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:22794
Court No. - 27

Case :- Criminal Revision No. - 202 of 2022
Revisionist :- Shiva Thru.

His Father Raj Kumar
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another
Counsel for Revisionist :- Durgendra Kumar Tiwari,Anjali Divedi,Purnima Singh,Vijay Prak
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Rajendra Prasad,Vinod Kumar
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vijay Prakash Srivastava, the learned counsel appearing for the revisionist, Smt. Parul
Kant, the learned Aga-I for the State and perused the record.

2. By means of the instant revision filed under Section 102 of the Juvenile Justice (Care and
Protection of Children) Act, the revisionist has challenged the validity of the orders dated 21.01.2022
passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Lucknow rejecting his application for release on bail and the
order dated 21.02.2022 passed by the Additional District and Sessions Judge/ Pocso Act, Court
No. 2, Lucknow dismissing Criminal Appeal No. 14 of 2022 filed by the revisionist against the order
rejecting his bail application.

3.The opposite party no. 2 had lodged Fir No. 382 of 2021 on 09.07.2021 alleging commission of
rape by the juvenile revisionist.
Shiva Thru.

4.

A supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the revisionist annexing therewith a copy of
the statement of the victim recorded by the trial court and she has been declared to be hostile.
5.  As the victim herself has turned hostile and has not supported the FIR allegation, I am of the view that the revision deserves to be allowed.
6. Accordingly, this revision stands allowed.

The orders dated 21.01.2022 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board, Lucknow and the order dated 21.02.2022 passed by the Additional District and Sessions Judge/ POCSO Act, Court No. 2, Lucknow, are set aside.

entities.text: Additional District and Sessions Judge/ POCSO Act, Court No. 2, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
7. Let the revisionist-Juvenile be released on bail in Case Crime No. 382 of 2021, under Sections 376, 504, 506 IPC and 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Thakurganj, District Lucknow upon his guardian furnishing a personal bond with two solvent sureties of his relatives, each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Juvenile Justice Board concerned subject to the following conditions:-
(i) the natural guardian will furnish an undertaking that upon release on bail the juvenile will not be permitted to come into contact or association with any known criminal or allowed to be exposed to any moral, physical or psychological danger and further that the guardian will ensure that the juvenile will not indulge in any criminal activity;
(ii) natural guardian will further furnish an undertaking to the effect that the juvenile will pursue his study at the appropriate level which he would be encouraged to do.
(iii) juvenile accompanied by his natural guardian, will report to the Probation Officer on the first working day of every calendar month.
The D.P.O. shall maintain a diary recording their attendance.

(iv) The District Probation Officer will keep strict vigil on the activities of the juvenile and regularly draw up his social investigation report that would be submitted to the Juvenile Justice Board concerned.

8. It is made clear that the observations made in this order are limited to the purpose of determination of this bail application and will in no way be construed as an expression on the merits of the case.
The trial court/J.J.Board shall be absolutely free to arrive at its independent conclusions on the basis of evidence led, uninfluenced by any finding or observation whatsoever in this order.

Order Date :- 14.3.2024 Pradeep/-
 
Shiva Thru.
